title: Sarkavag 42/15 Townhouses
price_currency_raw: 90 mln AMD unrenovated (284,360 AMD/m2); 116 mln AMD renovated (366,508 AMD/m2)
description: Gated development of 6 detached houses offered for sale from April 2018 in Kanaker-Zeytun. Each house has 316.5 m2 built area (203 m2 living, 93.5 m2 leisure hall, 20 m2 garage) and at least 450 m2 landscaped plot; all utilities (electricity, water, sewage, gas) connected, fenced, lit and paved common areas. Instalments over 15 months or mortgage up to 10 years. ADA Tech (founded 2010) reports 16 apartment buildings delivered in Yerevan as of 2018 and 6 more under construction, but the site does not name them.

title: Allur Residence Dilijan
description: Premium 13,000 m2 residential complex on a plateau in Dilijan on the site of the former Soviet Tavush bread factory, surrounded by Dilijan national park views. 3 residential blocks (block 1: 20 apts 44-125 m2; block 2: 45 apts 91-280 m2; block 3: 42 apts 42-233 m2), 92 apartments total, delivered white box with panoramic 'fourth glass wall' windows. Amenities: 9,700 m2 green zone and playground, 55 parking spaces, 500 m2 two-level coworking (50 seats), 620 m2 sports complex, cafe-boulangerie on the ground floor. Estimated finish date in site data: May 2024. Sales via City Nest (84-84). Russian catalog PDF: https://allur.am/pdf/Allur_Catalog_Digital_RUS.pdf

title: Noy Residential Complex
description: Ensemble of 5 detached apartment buildings (13-15 floors) with commercial premises on ground floors, 84 apartments with 3 m ceilings, in an existing residential cluster of Malatia-Sebastia. Builder: NOY INVEST GROUP LLC (Arare as designer/partner). Shop and playground on site; underground and surface parking; school, kindergarten, supermarket, park nearby. End date 07.2025.

title: D6 Symphony Tower (Davtashen)
description: Apartment building by ARARE LLC in Davtashen: 14 above-ground floors, 72 apartments, two-level underground parking plus surface parking, 2 floors of commercial space, landscaped yard and playground. Security: fenced perimeter, pass-entry, CCTV, 24/7 guard. Nearby schools, kindergarten, cinema, supermarket, polyclinic, gym. End date listed as 07.2025 and 03.2026.

title: Abovyan Multifunctional Residential Complex
description: Planned multifunctional residential complex in Abovyan (Kotayk) of four buildings, each 16 above-ground floors, with two underground parking levels, landscaped courtyards, children's playgrounds and recreation zones.

title: Nairi Residential Community
address: Proshyan community, ~5 km from Halabyan Street, Yerevan
description: 3.5 ha gated community (builder FLAGMAN LLC) of private houses with own backyards plus a public block (shop, kindergarten, playground, supermarket). 2.5 m perimeter wall, houses 3-6 m apart separated by greenery, optional enclosed parking and lounge; 9+ seismic design, B25 concrete / A500C rebar, LED street lighting, drip irrigation, pass-entry, CCTV and 24/7 security. End date 07.2025.

title: Five Towers Residential Complex
description: Complex of five 23-storey buildings (+2 underground levels) at Gevorg Chaush 95 near Vahagni district. Four buildings have 3 floors of commercial premises (shops, supermarket, services); the fifth includes a 4-storey business center. Site area 12,168 m2, 4,962 m2 green areas, 284 parking spaces, 24/7 security; children's playground, kindergarten, tennis court, football field, gym, EV charging. 929 apartments sold, 125 booked; end date August 2031. Buildings D, E, F have apartments on sale (3-room ~75-79 m2 from 40.6M AMD).

title: Atlantis Prime
description: Premium residential complex to be built in Arabkir next to Atlantis Yerevan: 17 above-ground floors, floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows with views of Mount Ararat, Komitas Avenue and Hrazdan Gorge. 125 parking spaces, 24/7 security. 57 offers on sale (2-room 56.8-64.6 m2, 3-room 88.6-111.8 m2), 93 apartments booked.

title: Komitas 60
price_currency_raw: Starting from 550,000,000 AMD (5-room 424.9 m2); 4-room 432.2 m2 600,000,000 AMD
description: Premium complex in Arabkir near Holy Cross Church, 8-19 floors plus 3 underground levels, facade in natural Armenian tuff. Views of Ararat, Aragats, Komitas and Azatutyun avenues. Entrance halls with Armenian ornaments, landscaped courtyards with fountains, lobbies, pool, gym, cafe, kindergarten, kids zone, 24/7 security and concierge. Site 6,154.9 m2, 2,450 m2 green, 210 parking spaces. 291 apartments sold; end date September 2025; 2 large units still offered.

title: Atlantis Yerevan Residential Complex
description: Premium residential complex of three buildings with large stained-glass panoramic windows at 6 Malkhasyants Lane, Arabkir. 17 floors plus 3 underground levels, site 6,113 m2, 2,520 m2 green areas, 352 parking spaces, 24/7 security. 505 apartments sold (sold out); end date August 2028.

title: Zoravar Andranik 121/6
description: High-class apartment building in Malatia-Sebastia (16 floors + 4 underground levels): high seismic resistance, views of Ararat and 'Love and Faith' park, natural stone cladding, European windows and two European elevators per entrance, sound and heat insulation, private playground, alleys and garden, 56 parking spaces, security. Site 1,249 m2, 500 m2 green. 64 apartments, sold out; end date December 2026.

title: Davit Bek 290 Residential Complex
address: Ar. Mikoyan Street 2/1 (corner of Davit Bek Street), Nor Nork 5th massif
description: Residential complex in Nor Nork 5th massif, at the intersection of Mikoyan and Davit Bek streets, in Yerevan's highest residential area: seismic stability, clean air, views of Ararat, St. Sarkis church and city skyline. 16 floors + 3 underground, site 3,790 m2, 1,530 m2 green, 136 parking spaces, 24/7 security. 291 apartments sold, 9 booked; end date December 2025.

title: Slavik Chiloyan 17
description: ARM Construct's first project, a residential building in Arabkir occupied for over 5 years; kids zone, green area and barbecue zone. Sold out. ARM Construct sales office is also located here.

title: Firdus Prime Residence
price_currency_raw: Listed apartments from 93,199,484 AMD (min ~1,153,935 AMD/m2 among priced units); most units sold
description: Art Company's redevelopment of the Firdusi quarter in central Yerevan, 2-3 minutes' walk from Republic Square, Ring Park, St. Gregory the Illuminator Cathedral and Vernissage. Totals: 12-17 floors, 3 blocks, 287 apartments, 114 parking spaces. Lots: 10-11 (2 blocks, 12 floors, 155 apts, 16 commercial, 26 parking); 14-A (3 blocks, 17 floors, 132 apts, 6 commercial, 88 parking); 12 (1 block, 19 floors, 175 apts, 8 commercial, 24 parking); 14-B (1 block, 17 floors, 87 apts, 9 commercial, 64 parking). Lots 9 and 13 also shown on the master plan. Sales office: Tsitsernakaberd highway 8/3; Tigran Mets 11.

title: Gyurjyan Cascade
description: New multifunctional district on the Nor Nork heights: 7.24 ha site with 30 residential buildings (groups A-J), 2 public buildings and a kindergarten; 2,605 apartments of 38.6-98.6 m2 and 1,825 underground parking spaces on 3 levels. Central cascade park, playgrounds and sports fields, pool, pet zone, EV charging; ~45% green area. Phase 1 (A-D) due summer 2028, phase 2 (E) end 2028, phase 3 (F, G) end 2029. Delivered with partitions plastered, screed floors, windows and entrance door installed. Live construction cameras and YouTube video on site.

title: Antar (Forest) Residential Complex
description: Premium multifunctional complex of 5 blocks (A-E) in Arabkir, ~50,000 m2 total area with ~5,000 m2 landscaped courtyard with water features. Amenities owned in common by residents: children's playroom, swimming pool, gym, leisure room, banquet hall, lobby. 5 underground levels with 187 parking spaces plus 40 guest spaces, 9-point seismic resistance, central heating and hot water. Construction completion planned 2024 (completion act published).

title: Ani Premium Residential Complex
description: Three 15-storey blocks (A, B, C) in Arabkir on a 8,201.59 m2 site: commercial space on floors 1-2, apartments of 59-99.79 m2 on floors 3-15, 270 apartments and 191 underground parking spaces (-1 level). ~40% green area, 9-point seismic resistance; kindergarten, school, supermarket, hospital nearby. Completion planned end of 2027; delivered with partitions, screed floors, aluminium balcony doors.

title: Dilijan Hotel-Guesthouse
description: Apartment-hotel complex of two blocks (A, B) in Dilijan, 5 above-ground floors plus basement with 24 parking spaces. Site 3,170 m2 (904.4 m2 built, 1,270 m2 green). Block B: 49 apartments of 21.55-57.67 m2 with public service areas on the ground floor, 9-point seismic resistance. Delivered renovated with kitchen furniture. Completion planned 2025.

title: Sose Hotel-Guesthouse
description: Hotel-guesthouse building in Arabkir: 2 basement floors, 3 above-ground floors and attic on a 486.1 m2 plot; 40 studio apartments of 21.9-29.8 m2, 1 passenger elevator, central heating/hot water and central ventilation/cooling, facade in basalt, tuff and travertine. Delivered renovated with kitchen furniture. Completion planned 2025.

title: Mamikonyants Residential District
description: Completed district of three 14-storey buildings (A-22, B-22/2, G-22/1) in Arabkir, 91 apartments per building (7 per floor, 55.2-155.6 m2), 3.0 m ceilings, passenger and freight elevators, individual heating, playgrounds, recreation zones, commercial premises and kindergarten. 9-point seismic resistance. Completed 2022 (occupancy permit).

title: Hambardzumyan Residential Complex
description: 13-storey building near Rio Mall in Arabkir with two underground floors (42 parking spaces), commercial premises of 164.2 and 171.6 m2 on the ground floor, 72 apartments (6 per floor, 58.1-156.7 m2), 3.0 m ceilings, passenger and freight elevators, individual heating, backup generator and water tanks, ceramic granite facade. Completed 2023.

title: Leningradyan Residential District
description: Three buildings (A and B 16 floors with 179 apartments of 51-116 m2; C 14 floors with 88 apartments of 51-83 m2), ~3,000 m2 courtyard with green zone and playground, ground-floor commercial space, two underground levels with 190 parking spaces, 3.0 m ceilings, individual heating, 9-point seismic resistance. Completed 2023.

title: Koghbatsi Residential Complex
description: 18-storey building in Yerevan's small centre near Republic Square metro: two underground parking levels (32 spaces), commercial space (189.6 m2) and restaurant hall on the ground floor, 161 apartments on floors 2-18 (37.5-49.1 m2 on 2-5; 44.6-87.6 m2 on 6-13; 63.5-112 m2 on 14-16; 163-209.4 m2 penthouses on 17), central heating, individual cooling, 3.0 m ceilings, 9-point seismic resistance. Commissioned September 2019.

title: Krunk Residential District
description: Residential district in Ajapnyak of 14-storey buildings, each with 91 apartments (7 per floor, 58.1-97.2 m2), courtyard with active/passive recreation zones, commercial premises, underground parking for 192 cars, 3.0 m ceilings, passenger and freight elevators, individual heating, 9-point seismic resistance. Construction completion 2023; district opening held 17 May 2025.

title: Mamikonyants 30/1 Residential Complex
description: 13-storey building in Arabkir with commercial space and one underground level (49 parking spaces): 71 apartments - 9 per floor on floors 5-11 (42.37-86.45 m2, 3.0 m ceilings) and 4 per floor on floors 12-13 (129.85-149.75 m2, 3.3 m ceilings); stained-glass windows, individual heating, passenger and freight elevators, 9-point seismic resistance. Completion 2024.

title: Ulnetsi Residential Building
description: Small 3-storey residential building with commercial space in Kanaker-Zeytun: 18 apartments (6 per floor, 37.89-98.25 m2), 3.0 m ceilings, 1 passenger elevator, individual heating, tuff facade. Completion 2024.

title: Ani Residential District
description: Completed district in Arabkir of five 12-storey buildings with 77 apartments each (7 per floor, 55.2-154.4 m2), courtyard with playgrounds, recreation zones and commercial premises, 3.0 m ceilings, passenger and freight elevators, individual heating, 9-point seismic resistance. Construction completed 2020; opening ceremony 22 May 2021.

title: Solar Residential Complex
description: New residential complex 'Solar' by Aygedzor LLC at Alma-Ata (Almaty) Street 1/4, Yerevan, with apartments on sale (Buy apartment section). The project page carries only renders; no specifications or prices published. Sales office: Acharyan Street 35/3.

title: Aygedzor Residential Complex
description: Multi-entrance residential building (16 floors per floor plans) with 10 stainless-steel elevators (2 per entrance). No gas in apartments: rooftop boiler house supplies heating and hot water; AC units placed on shared balconies behind metal screens. Landscaped courtyard with playground and pavilions, 24/7 security staff, fire hydrants, smoke extraction, CCTV in common areas, European aluminium thermal windows. Floor-by-floor sales availability and parking levels on site.

title: Paronyan 8 Apartment Building
description: Completed multi-apartment building at Paronyan 8 listed among Aygedzor's finished projects (other finished works are non-residential: Charles Aznavour house-museum, Arabkir church, Etchmiadzin, Eornekian school, Izmirlian center, CityZen kids city, radioisotope center).

title: Baghramyan Residence
price_currency_raw: Available apartments from 76,440,000 AMD (1-room 54.6 m2 equivalent ~1.4M AMD/m2); 3-room from 108,720,000 AMD
description: Premium 18-storey residential building on the first line of Marshal Baghramyan Avenue. Studios, 2-3 room apartments and penthouses (e.g. studio type 1 39.1 m2) with floor-to-ceiling windows toward the city and Ararat, BMS smart building system, Mitsubishi VRF HVAC, 24/7 security with CCTV, reception, 3 commercial floors (2,700 m2). Built by Haekshin, architecture The Esqiz, interiors Armat Studio; partners Domus and Inecobank. Payment: 500,000 AMD reservation, 30% down, interest-free instalments up to 40 months. 177 units listed on the apartments page (75 available at time of scrape).

title: AR23 Residence
description: Premium boutique building near RIO Mall in Arabkir by Brawerk (ex-Metsn Erik): 9 floors, only 33 apartments (2-3 rooms, 33.6-89.6 m2, 3 m ceilings) plus 7 commercial units on the second floor, 15 parking spaces, plot 667 m2. Greek panoramic windows, natural granite and Italian porcelain stoneware in lobbies, premium elevator, gas supply. Construction 16.04.2026 - 01.12.2028; sales opened June 2026; mortgage partner Ameriabank.

title: Alma-Ata Residence
description: Premium complex in Avan clad in travertine, basalt and tuff with enhanced sound/thermal insulation and seismic resistance. Site 1,600 m2 (875.5 m2 built), 2 entrances, 9 above-ground + 2 underground floors, 86 apartments (2-3 rooms, 48.3-90.3 m2, 3 m ceilings, open balconies), commercial space on the first floor, 28 parking spaces (6-7M AMD), gas. Construction 03.06.2024 - 03.06.2027; bank partner Ameriabank.

title: Riga House (Antarayin Residential Complex)
address: Aghbyur Serob Street 52/12 (Verin Antarayin Street, near RIO Mall)
description: Commissioned residential complex on Verin Antarayin street next to RIO Mall: unique five-wing plan giving multi-sided light and extra seismic stability, elevated site with views. 12 floors, 59 apartments (2-4 rooms, 55.6-208.2 m2, 3 m ceilings), 48 parking spaces, plot 1,231 m2, gas, security point, insulated aluminium windows. Construction 2021-2024; remaining units offered at 870-920k AMD/m2.

title: Capital Park Residential Complex
description: Residential complex at Shiraz 2, Ajapnyak: 5 blocks with 15 residential floors plus 1 commercial floor (16 above ground) and 3 underground parking levels; 524 apartments of 1-4 rooms, 36.4-126.5 m2. Monolithic reinforced-concrete frame, 9+ seismic rating, energy-efficient insulation, European-standard elevators, landscaped garden and playground. Delivered with partitions, plastered walls, levelled floors, windows and entrance door. Cash, staged payment or mortgage. Sales office at Shiraz 2 (Mon-Sat 10-19). No prices published; floor-by-floor availability chart on site.

title: Movenpick Resort Tsaghkadzor (branded hotel apartments)
description: 5-star Movenpick-branded resort in Tsaghkadzor sold as an investment programme: buyers purchase a fully renovated and furnished hotel room that is then operated long-term by the hotel. 197 units of 27-95 m2. Completion December 2026. Sales by City Nest (8484, +374 44 848 411).

title: Milano Firenze Towers
description: Prestigious mixed-use development in central Yerevan beside English Park and DoubleTree by Hilton, 5 minutes' walk to Republic Square; built to LEED Gold standards with apartments, commercial premises and offices. 152 apartments of 41-410 m2, 408 (also stated 242) parking spaces. Completion December 2028. Developer Renco; sales City Nest (+374 44 848844).

title: Only One Residential Complex
description: Luxury complex offering varied layouts and exclusive amenities with emphasis on privacy and community. 176 apartments of 44-291 m2, 242 parking spaces. Completion December 2025. Sales office Paronyan 40; City Nest 8484.

title: Aivazovsky Residential Complex
description: Complex inspired by Aivazovsky's 'The Ninth Wave': grand facade, gallery-like lobbies, sculpted courtyard, open-air swimming pool and panoramic views. 90 apartments of 38-228 m2, 66 parking spaces. Completion December 2027. Developer 4A Capital; sales City Nest 8484.

title: Nest Residence
description: Multifunctional residential complex of two buildings on elevated ground in Davtashen with views of Ararat and Hrazdan Gorge, sports and entertainment facilities for all ages, affordability focus. 170 apartments of 51-136 m2, 140 parking spaces. Completion August 2028. Sales City Nest 8484.

title: The Park Lvovyan
description: Modern residential building combining urban convenience with a green, tranquil setting. 103 apartments of 45-133 m2, 73 parking spaces. Completion December 2025. Sales City Nest 8484.

title: City View Residential Complex
description: Modern mono-building on the Babayan street highlands with panoramic views of Ararat and the city centre, near the Davit Anhaght transport hub, Babayan green zones and Zeytun park; outdoor kids and sports facilities. 73 apartments of 40-150 m2, 55 parking spaces. Completion September 2024. Sales City Nest 8484.

title: Mountain Village Dilijan
description: Gated residential complex in Dilijan blending urban and natural living with distinctive architecture and views; self-sufficient infrastructure nearby. 22 apartments of 52-190 m2, 39 parking spaces. Completion March 2025. Sales City Nest 8484.

title: Tigran Mets Residence
description: Large residential complex with walking and cycling lanes, landscaped gardens with fountains, 24/7 concierge and home cleaning, summer pool; views of Ararat, Yerevan Park and Dalma Gardens. 420 apartments of 62-150 m2, 340 parking spaces. Completion December 2024. Developer Tigran Mets Group; sales City Nest 8484.

title: TM Tower
description: 27,000 m2 high-tech skyscraper with exterior structural frame, billed as Yerevan's tallest residential building: 9 lower floors of retail and offices with separate lobby, 25 residential floors above. Next to Dalma Gardens and Tsitsernakaberd with views of Ararat, Yerevanyan Lake and the centre. 183 apartments of 38-124 m2, 160 parking spaces. Completion June/December 2026. Developer Tigran Mets Group; sales City Nest.

title: Nor Etch Residential
description: First new residential building in Etchmiadzin in 40 years, mixing the city's heritage with French architectural elements, 80 m from the Mother Cathedral and Komitas Park. 29 apartments (for ~40 families) of 60-139 m2, 11 parking spaces. Completion October 2023. Sales City Nest 8484.

title: Etchmiadzin 11/4 Business Center
description: Commercial/business centre marketed by City Nest: 18 levels, 200 parking lots, total area 8,000 m2; sale from $2,500/m2 or lease $20/m2 excluding VAT.

title: Firdus Square
address: 33rd district, between Khanjyan, Tigran Mets and Hanrapetutyan streets
description: Premium-class project in the heart of Yerevan (33rd district): 2 residential buildings of 12 floors with commercial 1st-2nd floors, 2 business centres and 1 hotel, 3-level underground parking. Already on sale; floor plans for building 1 and 2. Sales +374 10 566 922 / +374 10 566 933. Note: income tax refund law does not apply.

title: Almast Residence
address: Intersection of Eminescu and Rubinyants streets
description: Elite Group's first comfort-class project in Zeytun: 6 residential buildings (A, B, C, D, B1, C1) plus 1 commercial building, 12/14/16 floors, 426 apartments of 40-145 m2, multifunctional children's square, 4 underground levels with 460 parking spaces. Sold out; construction photo reports 2021-2022.

title: Northern Ray 2 Villas
address: Monument area, continuation of Northern Ray 1
description: Premium villa district continuing Northern Ray 1 near the Mother Armenia monument: 27 villas of 4 types (A, B, C, D), monolithic RC frame, 3.6 m ceilings (A-C ground and first floors), 3.3 m in type D, European doors/windows, garages for 2 cars (A-C) or 1 car (D). All houses sold.

title: Dzorap 2
address: Dzorap Street (next to Dzorap 1), Hrazdan gorge
description: Business-class residential complex on Dzorap Street next to Dzorap 1 in the green Hrazdan gorge, close to the city centre with views of Masis, Aragats and the Yerevan amphitheatre. 16 floors plus -1 parking. Sold out.

title: Northern Ray - 74 Nairi Zaryan
description: Business-class building of the Northern Ray urban project (Tamanyan's axis from the Mother Armenia memorial toward Babayan and Zaryan streets): two stepped buildings at the end of a pedestrian boulevard lined with 3-storey villas. 14 floors, 276 apartments of 64-214 m2, 3-level underground parking for 350 cars, central heating, security, maintenance. Apartments sold out; commercial property for sale.

title: Northern Ray 1
address: Northern Ray pedestrian boulevard (Nairi Zaryan / Babayan)
description: First phase of Northern Ray: pedestrian street lined with 3-storey villas leading to two stepped apartment buildings. Sold out.

title: Sayat-Nova 19/1
description: Premium-class tower at Sayat-Nova Avenue and Abovyan Street near Ani Plaza: 22 floors, 102 apartments of 95-297 m2, 3-level underground parking for 114 cars, central heating and air conditioning, security, maintenance. Sold out; commercial property for sale.

title: Demirtchyan 1
description: Premium building next to the National Assembly and Lovers' Park, in green surroundings: 10 floors, 51 apartments of 69-192 m2, 3-level underground parking for 84 cars, central heating and air conditioning, security. Sold out.

title: Baghramyan 59
description: Imposing building mid-Baghramyan Avenue: 17 floors, 110 apartments of 55-189 m2, 3-level underground parking for 103 cars, central heating and air conditioning, security, maintenance, high seismic stability. All apartments sold.

title: Mamikoniants 41
description: Business-class building near Komitas Avenue with views of Ararat and Aragats: 19 floors, 82 apartments of 75-154 m2, 2-level underground parking for 34 cars, security, maintenance. Sold out.

title: Dzorap 40
description: Business-class complex along the Hrazdan canyon with views of Ararat, Tsitsernakaberd and Aragats: 16 floors, 104 apartments of 76-248 m2, 3-level underground parking for 181 cars, central heating, security. Sold out.

title: Rostom 29 (Our Yard)
description: 'Our Yard' complex near St. Gregory the Illuminator cathedral and the Ring Park, distinctive colour scheme and cosy courtyard: 17 floors, 186 apartments of 63-172 m2, 2-level underground parking for 259 cars, central heating, security. Sold out.

title: Aram 64
address: Aram Street 64 (Mashtots Avenue, next to Charents house-museum)
description: Premium building between Mashtots Avenue and the Hrazdan canyon/children's railway: 16 floors, 112 apartments of 135-272 m2, 2-level underground parking for 140 cars, central heating and air conditioning. Sold out.

title: Amiryan 27
description: One of Elite Group's first projects, near Mashtots Avenue and Republic Square, with fitness centre: 18 floors, 85 apartments of 119-295 m2, underground parking for 85 cars, central heating and air conditioning. Sold out.

title: Demirtchian 12-14
description: Premium building near the Parliament and Presidential residence, beside a park: 14 floors, 39 apartments of 80-320 m2, underground parking for 45 cars, central heating and air conditioning. Sold out.

title: Komitas 12
description: Business-class building on Komitas: 10 floors, 19 apartments of 69-192 m2, central heating, security, maintenance. Sold out.

title: Pushkin 21
description: Elite Group's first project, three buildings completed in 2003 with a courtyard: 9 floors, 57 apartments of 116-260 m2, underground parking for 64 cars, central heating. Sold out.

title: Elite Plaza Business Center
address: Movses Khorenatsi Street 15 (near Central Bank / Republic Square)
description: Class A business centre (IFC criteria) near the Central Bank and Republic Square: 19 floors, 7 elevators (2 panoramic), separate entrances for shopping centre and offices, panoramic glazing, two-level underground parking for 120 cars.

title: Elite Villa Tsaghkadzor
address: Tsaghkadzor, near Marriott hotel and ropeway
description: 45 mansions at 1,800 m altitude in Tsaghkadzor with views of the town and Kecharis monastery, 3 minutes from the ropeway; shared security and service with the adjacent Marriott (restaurant, pool, tennis, football). Houses of 202 and 240 m2 on 300-700 m2 plots, with gas. Villas for sale: nos. 5, 16, 27, 38.

title: Best Resort Aghveran
address: Aghveran, left bank of Dalar river
description: Operating hotel 40 km from Yerevan on a 6 ha forest site below the Tsaghkunyats range: 56 rooms, indoor and outdoor pools, bowling, sauna, sports grounds, children's room. Website aghveranhotel.am.

title: Jermuk Resort & Spa
address: Upper platform of Arpa river canyon, Jermuk
description: Luxury resort & spa complex of three buildings with 188 rooms, set to be the largest in Jermuk.

title: Barekamutyun Residential Complex
description: Multi-apartment monolithic reinforced-concrete residential complex with turnkey apartments in the Barekamutyun area of Yerevan, built by Filishin (contractor/developer). Delivered.

title: Dzorap 70/3 & 70/2 Residential Buildings
description: Multi-apartment monolithic reinforced-concrete residential buildings with public-use ground floors at Dzorap 70/3 and 70/2, built 2013-2015.

title: Residential Complex, 131 Antarayin Street
description: Multi-apartment monolithic reinforced-concrete residential complex with turnkey apartments at 131 Antarayin Street, built 2015-2018.

title: Residential and Public Building with Zigzag Showroom (Charents 24)
description: Mixed-use monolithic building combining apartments with the ground-floor Zigzag retail showroom on Charents Street, completed 2005.

title: Green Hills Residential Complex
address: Davit Bek Street 103/5 (site address given as 'operating address'; office Antarayin 170)
description: Green Hills complex: 9-point seismic design, tuff and basalt sound/thermal-insulating cladding, energy-saving aluminium windows, soundproof party walls, 4 elevators, electric heating, own electrical substation, pump station, intercom, CCTV, fire alarm and suppression. Amenities: large underground car park with CCTV and car-wash point, gym, children's development centre, open-air cafe on the ground floor, EV charging, supermarket in the building. Apartment selector by floor (floors 1-7 shown) and virtual tour on site; no prices published.

title: Talin Queen
price_currency_raw: Price from AMD 24,000,000; studio 44 m2 AMD 16,500,000; 3-room 92 m2 AMD 34,000,000; duplex 120 m2 AMD 46,000,000
description: Hamedil's largest residential project in Talin: 9-floor monolithic RC building (high seismic standard), 48 fully finished apartments of 42-120 m2 (studio, 1-3 bedrooms, 4-room duplex), glazed balconies, independent heating, underground parking, car-free courtyard with playground, elevator, 24-hour security. Started October 2026; 12 apartments remaining.

title: Talin Multihouse
price_currency_raw: Price from AMD 18,500,000 (1-room 38 m2); 2-room corner 76 m2 AMD 26,000,000
description: Five-storey building in a residential district of Talin with 30 one- and two-bedroom apartments (38-76 m2) handed over at first-fix stage, ground-floor retail, elevator, independent heating, seismic-resistant frame, landscaped courtyard. Construction started June 2024, completion planned October 2026; reservations open.

title: High Park Residential Community
description: Gated community of luxury modern detached houses in Avan, 7 km from Yerevan centre, designed with Cherkezyan & Partners. Three models: Model 1 500 m2 (4 bed, 5 bath, 2-car garage, pool and sauna, garden), Model 2 350 m2 (4 bed, 4 bath), Model 3 190 m2 (3 bed, 3 bath, 1-car garage). Reinforced-concrete seismic foundations, basalt and travertine facades, landscaped gardens, flat roofs ready for solar panels or terraces. Brochure PDF: https://www.highparkyerevan.com/_files/ugd/4b9a41_9a60798929ea4eb9b05918177a662370.pdf . No prices published.

title: Kamertoon Multifunctional Complex
address: Sergei Parajanov Street 8 (next to Parajanov Museum)
price_currency_raw: No prices published; maintenance fee AMD 800-900/m2 per month
description: Premium multifunctional complex in the Hrazdan Gorge at Parajanov 8: only 21 fully finished apartments with private terraces (lots ~90-175 m2 on floors 2-6 plus penthouses on floor 7), offices and commercial spaces, medical centre on floor 1, parking, The Atrium cultural space, Secret Garden, open-air rooftop restaurant. Ararat views from every apartment, 3.2 m ceilings, purified air and softened water, internationally certified sustainable design. Amenities: concierge, [K] Club, valet parking, car-sharing, carwash, wellness/yoga, room service, 24/7 security. Built by BEDECK Construction, architects PROFORMA. Structure done April-May 2026; full handover September 2027.

title: Luyser Residential Complex
address: Leningradyan Street 23/7 (between Leningradyan and Monte Melkonyan streets, Dalma Gardens)
description: Four buildings (A and B 18 floors, C and D 16 floors) with Ararat views on a 12,200 m2 site in Dalma Gardens, only 3,000 m2 built up - the rest a car-free green courtyard with running track, mini-football and basketball courts, playgrounds and gazebos. 3 underground levels with 404 parking spaces, 3 European elevators per building, bike parking and storage, energy-efficiency certificate, hidden AC/boiler equipment, green balconies. Apartments 44-186 m2 (6-7 per floor, combinable), floor-to-ceiling thermal windows, large balconies. First phase commissioned 2024; construction completion 2027. 5 km from Republic Square, 850 m from Tumo park.

title: Luyser Center
description: 14,300 m2 multifunctional centre 200 m from Luyser residential complex: medical services, food and leisure venues, gym with indoor football pitch, and office floors in a tower with European panoramic glazing modules. Separate elevators and stairwells per functional zone (5 elevators, 4 stairwells), 9-point seismic design on a 1.2 m RC raft, 2 backup generators, water reservoir, 80 underground (3 levels) + 25 surface parking spaces.

title: Monte Residential Complex
price_currency_raw: Prices not published (apartment list shows 0 AMD); mortgage calculator 10-30% down
description: Residential complex developed by Elite Residence CJSC with construction supervised by Russian developer PROGRESS LLC: 6 buildings (1-4, 5-1, 5-2), 16 floors, 566 apartments of ~41-183 m2 (few units still available in buildings 2-5). ~7,000 m2 of public space with dining, spa, playground and meeting rooms, a new school being built within the complex, over 60% green area, facades in local stone and travertine with European insulation systems. Construction completion promised by December 2026. Sales office Leningradyan 31/3.

title: Mountain Plaza Residential Complex
description: Gated residential building in a quiet green area with city and mountain views: 2 entrances, 5 floors, 55 apartments of various layouts (1-4+ bedrooms), commercial space, underground parking, CCTV, 24/7 security, concierge, fitness centre, large playground and park. Architecture by Benoit Architecture; Schindler elevators, Italian gas boilers, chiller cooling/heating. Delivered semi-finished (plastered, wiring, heating, windows, entrance door) with optional turnkey finishing. Payment: one-off or mortgage (10%+ discount) or 1/3/5-year instalments. Construction completion end of 2026, completion certificate spring 2027.

title: Garni Private House
description: Completed two-storey private house in Garni (2021-2022), 520 m2, 5 rooms, heated swimming pool, gazebo and barbecue. Offered for sale by Muar Group.

title: Two-storey Private House, Getapnya (Ararat)
description: Newly built two-storey stone house in Ararat province (2025-2026), handed over with full renovation; 4 rooms, 96 m2 listed unit.

title: Getapnya Residential Complex
description: Four-storey residential building with 40 apartments under construction by Muar Group in Ararat town (start Aug 2026, planned completion Aug 2027). 2- and 3-room apartments of ~54-82 m2 with floor plans on site.

title: Dilijan Social Housing Complex
address: Dilijan (land plot and unfinished building provided by Dilijan municipality)
description: First social affordable rental housing project in Armenia (Dutch-Armenian cooperation) for middle-income Dilijan families (household income AMD 200-250k/month). Phased: phase I - 16 energy-efficient terraced-housing apartments, completed December 2014 (financed by Dutch International Guarantees for Housing, guaranteed by Groen West); phase II - 38 apartments (18 terraced + 20 in a reconstructed apartment building) subject to investment; phase III - 150 apartments; target up to 200 managed social rental/affordable units.

title: Nova Building
price_currency_raw: Available apartments from 33,030,000 AMD (1-room); promo 20% down, 60 months 0%
description: Modern 17-storey residential complex of three blocks (A, B, C) in Kanaker-Zeytun, 5 minutes from Erazi (Dream) park: 504 apartments, 348 parking spaces on 4 underground levels with EV charging, 3 commercial floors (10,000 m2), ventilated facade, floor-to-ceiling windows, gas with 2 points, free gas boiler and air conditioners, playground, 24/7 security. Built by Haekshin, architecture The Esqiz; partners Domus and Ardshinbank. Construction completion 2029. Payment: 10% down, interest-free up to 40 months (promo 20%/60 months/0%). Sales office Ler Kamsar 30/3.

title: Komitas Park Residential District (Phases 1-2)
address: Between Griboyedov, Mamikonyants and Tigranyan streets (sales office Mamikonyants 38/3)
description: Multifunctional residential district in Arabkir along the Northern Ray axis: phases 1 and 2 comprise 24 buildings of 12 and 16 floors with 1,800 apartments and as many parking spaces (2-level underground). 2-4 room apartments of 47-116 m2 with open balconies, handed over with plastered partitions, windows and doors, gas with individual heating. Car-free inner courtyards, pedestrian alley-park with fountains, pet zone, bike lane, 24-hour security, ground-floor shops/services; managed by the developer. Mortgage with income-tax refund or staged payment.

title: Komitas Park Residential District - Phase 3
address: Between Griboyedov, Mamikonyants and Tigranyan streets, Arabkir
description: Third phase of Komitas Park launched: another 15 buildings with 1,400 apartments and the same number of parking spaces, including a high-rise at the centre of the district. On completion the district will total 3,200 apartments, 3,300 parking spaces, 17,000 m2 of public space and ~35,000 m2 of green space, water features, playgrounds and alleys.

title: Park Royal Tsaghkadzor
developer: Kechi Hangstyan Tun LLC (Park Royal Tsaghkadzor)
description: Multifunctional residential complex in the centre of Tsaghkadzor next to Kecharis monastery: 8 above-ground floors plus 1 underground level with 15 parking spaces; 53 apartments of 44.2-197 m2 (plus exclusive 447 m2 units) of which 32 available and 21 reserved. Marketed for living and investment (resort feel, rental income) with income-tax refund up to AMD 750,000 per quarter. Sales office Yerevan, Teryan 66.

title: Legrand Park Residential and Commercial District
description: Planned mixed-use district transforming a 2.54 ha industrial plot in Yeghegnadzor: 7 residential buildings (2.92 ha total floor area) with 400 apartments, >80% residential, ground-floor commercial space (banks, restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, pharmacies, kindergarten) and public areas. ~USD 15M investment; land-use change under review, construction planned Aug 2025 - Dec 2027. Project management by ProjectEVN.

title: Dilijan Residential Compound (Dilijan Project)
address: Dilijan, 4.3 km from the M-4/M-8 highway intersection
description: USD 30M, 3 ha residential compound in Dilijan: 24 terraced single-family houses with green terraces (d'Arvestanoc Studio); multifunctional complex with ~85 rental apartments, fitness club with pool, minimarket, cafe, rooftop restaurant and coworking (SNKH Studio); 4-star Hilton hotel with conference hall (STOHA); 6,000+ m2 ring-shaped park with water features, 2 sports fields and 2 playgrounds (KOTSIUBA). Construction end projected 2028.

title: Areni Guest House
description: USD 1M reconstruction of four old village houses in Areni into a premium guest house preserving traditional character, with pool, bar and wine shop; architect SNKH Studio, investor Areni Traditional Hospitality. Delivery planned beginning of 2026.

title: Lavan Sevan
description: Early-stage sustainable development on the Sevan Peninsula inside Sevan National Park; design permit obtained and preliminary design finalised with ProjectEVN's help. No size or programme details published.

title: Kamar Multifunctional Business Complex
address: Vazgen Sargsyan Street 26/1 (address from public sources; not stated on site)
description: Multifunctional business complex 'Kamar' whose construction project was launched by Property Development Company CJSC. The site gives no further specifications. Other listed works are consultancy/technical supervision (Ameriabank branches, Wings of Tatev ropeway, Dilijan International School) rather than developments.

title: Riverview Dilijan
description: Premium residential complex on the Aghstev riverbank, 5-7 minutes' walk from central Dilijan and surrounded by forest: blocks A and B of 4 floors each, 75 units from 25 m2 studios to 164 m2 penthouses plus 8 townhouses of ~100 m2 with private patios. Site ~4,000 m2 (1,500 m2 built). Architecture by Kulthome in Dilijan's classic style. Riverside gazebos, green alleys, playground, parking, fishing, 24/7 CCTV and guarded access, concierge, gardener and cleaning, central heating. Sold without finishing (aluminium windows, metal door, plastered walls). Staged payment (interest-free until completion) or mortgage with income-tax refund; live construction stream.

title: Yeraz (Eraz) Residential District
address: Yerevan (exact site address not published; developer office Adonts Street 8)
description: Yeraz residential district, developed by Mikshin LLC and built entirely by its sister company ST Service LLC (300 staff): large landscaped green areas, children's and sports playgrounds, pools and fountains, organised surface and underground parking, business centres, affordable apartments with favourable mortgage terms and high-level district maintenance. No specifications, prices or address given on either website.

title: New Shengavit Residential District
price_currency_raw: Listed sale prices ~510,000-800,000 AMD/m2 (most units sold); commercial rent 375,000-1,800,000 AMD/month + VAT
description: Residential district 500 m from Garegin Nzhdeh and Shengavit metro stations: 271 apartments of 29.5-101.5 m2 (1-3 rooms), 500 parking spaces, 3 m ceilings, 4 elevators. Building N3 has 3 underground and 18 above-ground floors (ground floor commercial), 2 entrances with 8 apartments per floor, 3-level underground parking under the whole courtyard, landscaped public garden; security point, supermarket, restaurant, bank, kindergarten and schools nearby. Planned completion 1 July 2025.

title: Panorama Dalma (Phase I)
address: Tsitsernakaberd Highway (next to Sports and Concert Complex)
price_currency_raw: Listed prices ~650,000-875,000 AMD/m2 (phase I sold out)
description: Large district on a 6.43 ha sloping plot beside the Sports and Concert Complex along Tsitsernakaberd highway, built on 3 terraces in 4 phases: 19 residential buildings around a long public park with amphitheatre, ~2,400 apartments of 1-4 rooms, bridge-platform cafe and restaurant halls with Ararat valley views, 5 parking levels for 4,031 cars. Phase I: 528 apartments of 28-160 m2, 365 parking, 14 elevators, 10,642 m2 site, 3 m ceilings; planned completion 30 Sep 2025.

title: Panorama Dalma (Phase II)
address: Tsitsernakaberd Highway (next to Sports and Concert Complex)
description: Second phase of the Panorama Dalma district (see phase I): further residential buildings around the central park with amphitheatre on Tsitsernakaberd highway; no phase-specific figures published.

title: Avan Wings
description: Current Sahakyanshin residential project in Avan at Marshal Babajanyan 3/3; renders and master plan published, no specifications.

title: Vernissage Business Center
description: Class A business centre near Republic Square opened 2018: 11-12 office floors of 400 m2 each, 7,500 m2 total, 30 parking spaces, 2 elevators; tenants include KfW, GIZ, DSIK, SuperAnnotate. Offered for lease.

title: Basic Center Shopping Center
description: Shopping centre in Avan (2,500 m2, 4 m ceilings, 3 elevators, 30 parking spaces) completed 1998; retail/restaurant units for lease, currently leased.

title: Nazarbekyan Towers
description: Residential complex of 3 buildings on an 8,393 m2 site (2,600 m2 built, ~30%) with car-free landscaped courtyard, playground, fountain and gazebos. Building A: 14 floors, 67 apartments (2-4 rooms, 44-170 m2, 8 with terraces) + 6 commercial units; B: 16 floors, 160 apartments (2-3 rooms, 45-92 m2); G: 21 floors, 198 apartments (2-3 rooms, 50-90 m2). 425 apartments total, 2-level underground parking for 280 cars, European elevators, combinable apartments, 2 bathrooms in 3-4 room units. 300 m from the North-South highway near Vahagni district and Garage Mall. Architect MIROAR LLC, builder SHINVECTOR LLC.

title: Nor Silikyan Residential Quarter
description: Gated townhouse quarter of 18,000 m2 next to the existing Silikyan district: 72 two-storey houses (125-250 m2; plots 157-350 m2, incl. 9 detached houses on 280-350 m2 plots) with cascading layout, flat roofs, underground or surface parking, plus 2 public buildings (shopping hall, pharmacy, child development centre). 43% landscaped, 2 guarded entrances/exits, views of Ararat, Aragats and Ara. Access from old/new Movses Silikyan highway and North-South highway. Architect MIROAR, builder MEGASHIN LLC.

title: Prime Park Residential Complex
address: Leningradyan Street 27/6 (between Monte Melkonyan and Leningradyan streets, next to Yerevan Park)
description: Complex of 3 buildings (A 14, B 16, G 18 floors) on a 6,750 m2 site (2,700 m2 built, 4,050 m2 courtyard) next to Yerevan Park: 425 apartments of 54-110 m2 (2-4 rooms), 321 parking spaces on 3 underground levels, 6 elevators, 3 m ceilings, security point. Heated swimming pool, multi-sport court, landscaped gardens, distinctive lobbies, beauty salon, gym, market and public spaces.

title: T. Petrosyan 80 Residential Complex
description: Comfort-class complex in Davtashen, sales launched: 2 buildings with 365 apartments of 37-104 m2 (2-4 rooms, 36 layouts, floors 1-14), 3-level underground parking, green courtyard with children's playground and sports ground, BOON smart video intercom, CCTV and access control, panoramic glazing, monolithic RC frame, 'koroed' decorative plaster facades, A+ energy class. Quick link to the centre via Davtashen bridge.

title: Gyulikevkhyan 14/2 Residential Complex
price_currency_raw: 3-room from 45,307,500 AMD; 4-room 52,635,000-53,790,000 AMD (95.7-97.8 m2); parking from 5,000,000 AMD; 0% instalments
description: Completed comfort-class complex on elevated ground, school and kindergarten 5 minutes away: green courtyard, children's playground and football pitch, 2-level underground parking keeping the yard car-free, A+ energy class, monolithic RC frame with block walls insulated by 100 mm basalt wool. A few 3- and 4-room apartments remain (4 apartments on sale), 0% instalment plan.

title: Shiraz Residential Complex
price_currency_raw: 3-room from 47,740,000 AMD; 4-room from 52,554,000 AMD; parking from 5,000,000 AMD
description: Completed comfort-class complex on Shiraz Street next to a landscaped park, supermarkets, school and kindergarten (5 minutes' walk): ~900 m2 green courtyard, 2-level underground parking, BOON app access control and CCTV, stroller storage on the ground floor, Deceuninck 6-chamber windows, individual ventilation ducts, 4 elevators (2 passenger, 2 freight) with soundproofed shafts. 6 apartments still on sale.

title: Nansen Residential Complex
address: Nansen Street (near Nansen park and Megamall)
description: Completed Solar City project near Nansen park and Megamall: central heating and cooling with per-apartment control, views of Ararat, Yerevan and Nansen park, green zones, walking paths, gazebos, playground and football pitch, A+ energy-efficient construction, German Salamander windows and fire-resistant structures.

title: Solar City Eco-District (Townhouses)
description: Completed eco-district of 19 townhouses of 'Azhdahak' and 'Gandzak' types plus a 3-storey building with 7 apartments and underground parking, guest parking; inverter heat pumps for heating/cooling, supply-exhaust ventilation with heat recovery, A+ energy class. Walking distance to Megamall, supermarkets, schools and Nansen park.

title: Lusabac (Sunrise) Residential Complex
description: Premium residential complex on elevated ground with Ararat panoramas, sold directly by the developer with instalment plans (sales launched; first apartments sold). Apartments/spaces of 70-440 m2 with spacious terraces, sold with pre-finish or turnkey (design, renovation, furnishing packages). Rooftop swimming pool, landscaped areas, playgrounds, modern terraces, parking, modern elevators, central heating, commercial space. Floor plans with filters by area/floor/terrace on site.

title: Pullman Residences Yerevan
price_currency_raw: Prices on request; payment plan 30% down, 2%/month of balance over 30 months, 10% at handover
description: Premium Pullman-branded (Accor licence) residential complex on the Nork hills, 3-7 minutes from the centre and ~150 m above it with Ararat views. 20,000 m2 site with only 20% built: 8,000 m2 indoor common areas, 16,000 m2 green area, 3,000 m2 sports facilities; spa and wellness, restaurants and club lounges, coworking, kids' club, walking areas, parking. Pullman Living fully furnished extended-stay residences with hotel services; whole complex serviced by Pullman staff to Accor standards, residents get Accor ALL Platinum status. 10 residence types; catalogue, 3D tour and construction progress on site. Developer TechnoTun LLC (formerly marketed TECHNODOM Cascade).

title: Tsaghkunk Townhouses (Locations 1-2)
description: First two phases: seven 130 m2 townhouses on plots from 150 m2, all sold at excavation stage; by winter 2025 owners were finishing interiors. Monolithic frame, free-plan delivery.

title: Tsaghkunk Smart Hills 3 (Location 3)
price_currency_raw: From $130,000 per house (company-wide from $900/m2); 1 of 3 houses available
description: Three townhouses (130 m2, plots from 100 m2) oriented with gardens and bedroom windows south toward Ararat, in a quiet family neighbourhood with clean air; construction began January 2026, handover July 2026; delivered free-plan with optional partitions.

title: Arinj Townhouses (Location 4)
price_currency_raw: From $140,000 per house; 2 of 10 available; income-tax refund available
description: 10 new detached-style townhouses in central Arinj, each with its own 120 m2 plot; houses share only the foundation with garages between them (no party walls). Modern design; handover Q3 2026.

title: Ashtarak Highway Townhouses (Location 5)
address: Ashtarak highway, between SoftConstruct, Akademgorodok and Homplex (yandex.com/maps/-/CHXPNGyJ)
description: Planned 15 modern houses in two rows along Ashtarak highway on plots from 200 m2, garages between houses (shared foundation only), Ararat panoramas and milder climate above the city; project under approval.

title: Oasis Gated Village
address: Near Ashtarak highway, ~10 minutes' drive from Yerevan city limits (near Homplex)
description: Concept for a closed mini-community for tech specialists and repatriates/relocants: 10 individual houses and 10 townhouses in one architectural ensemble, 70-130 m2 houses with garage each, plots 100-200 m2, monolithic construction, green streets, limited to 20-30 families; currently collecting buyer feedback.

title: Vahakni Residential Community
description: Gated American-style residential community built by Hovnanian International: detached house models Taleen (1 floor, 171 m2 incl. garage, 2 bed), Van (2 floors, 212 m2, 3 bed), Ani, Artsakh, Dilijan, Ararat; townhouse models A-F (~123-156 m2, 2-3 bed, garages, basements); apartments; and improved lots for custom homes (phase 2 and 5 plots 1,000-1,500+ m2, phase 4 650-1,000 m2, phase 13 750+ m2). Amenities: Ararat Valley Country Club, executive golf course, tennis, football and basketball courts, restaurant, swimming pool, mini-market, QSI international school, Rainbow kindergarten. Houses for sale or rent; interactive map and 360 tours on site.

title: Vahakni Urban Settlement (2,300 apartments, Arthur Meschian design)
address: South-eastern section of Vahakni district, Gevorg Chaush Street 50 area
description: Approved future project within Vahakni: an urban settlement of 2,300 apartments designed by architect Arthur Meschian with cascading 'waterfall' building arrangement and full small-town infrastructure. Also planned: trade and cultural centre (shops, cinema, bank, spa), school and kindergarten, and the 7 ha 'Armenia Wonderland' theme park with miniature historical monuments.

title: Verelk Residential District
description: Mid-rise district in Arinj one street from Yerevan: 6 residential buildings (3 on each side) of 6 floors with 12 entrances, apartments 39-104.8 m2, underground and surface parking, commercial spaces, modern elevators, landscaped courtyards, rooftop open-air terraces, 9-11 point seismic rating. From 350,000 AMD/m2 in pre-sale; income-tax refund, instalments with 30% down, mortgages via partner banks.

title: Vahan Teryan 1st Street 9, 9/1, 9/2, 9/3 Buildings
description: Completed and fully inhabited multi-apartment buildings in Arinj built to modern seismic and comfort standards.

title: Acharyan 35/74 Townhouse Complex
description: Townhouse complex completed within one year (2020): each townhouse with its own entrance and private outdoor space, contemporary design and smart building technologies.

title: Acharyan 4/4 Residential Building
description: Verelq 777's first project: multi-apartment residential building started 2018 and completed 2019 to technical and seismic safety standards.

title: Zard by Zover Estates
price_currency_raw: Starting from 300,000 AMD/m2; exclusive mortgage rate 12.75%
description: City-district in Kanakeravan minutes from Yerevan, in pre-sale: 424,000 m2 (26 ha) total area, 41 buildings of 9-15 floors, 14 floor plans with apartments of 47.2-74.2 m2, 40% green space, ~15,000 future residents; built-in schools, kindergartens, shops, sports grounds and development centres. Special programmes for Artsakh residents and Ministry of Defense housing, income-tax refund, Ameriabank mortgage at 12.75%. Zover produces its own materials (ThyssenKrupp, Knauf, Technonicol suppliers).

title: Zover Eco Residence
description: Completed and sold-out green family community on the Davtashen-Zovuni border: 13 buildings of 10-15 storeys, 980 apartments, 34,000 m2 built-up area, balcony on every apartment.

title: Leveloft by Zover
description: Completed, sold-out modern complex in Avan: 5 buildings of 9-11 storeys, 192 apartments, 10,000 m2 built-up area, individually regulated heating, balconies throughout, fully gasified, green courtyard.

title: Kanaker by Zover
description: Completed, sold-out single 9-storey building in Kanaker with 59 apartments and 7,299 m2 built-up area, focused on comfort, technology and security.

title: Yeraz Business Park
address: Yerevan (next to Yeraz residential district; address not published)
description: Business park listed in Mikshin LLC's portfolio alongside the Yeraz residential district (JS-rendered site; only title and render published).
